summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Book a Trial button flow - all major functionality working correctly including navigation, form validation, theme toggles, and multi-step registration process
passed_tests: Book A Trial button navigation to /get-started page
Get-started page displays Consumer and Fleet Owner cards correctly
Both cards have target='_blank' for new tab functionality
Consumer page loads with light theme (amber/yellow aesthetic)
Consumer page has Book a Trial and Returning Customer tabs
Consumer registration form contains all required fields (Name, Email, Phone, Address, Preferred Trial Date)
Consumer form validation works correctly showing error messages for required fields
Consumer form submission works with valid data
Consumer theme toggle switches between light and dark modes
Fleet-portal page loads with dark theme (dark with orange accents)
Fleet-portal page has Register Fleet and Sign In tabs
Fleet multi-step registration Step 1 (Driver Info) - Full Name, Email, Phone, Driver License fields
Fleet multi-step registration Step 2 (Company) - Company Name, Fleet Size, DOT Number, Insurance fields
Fleet multi-step registration Step 3 (Vehicle) - Vehicle Type, Size, License Plate, Capacity, Password fields
Fleet registration Back/Continue navigation buttons work correctly
Fleet registration form submission works and shows success confirmation
Fleet theme toggle switches between dark and light modes
All required data-testid attributes present for testing
